sources.title: Zils — miners
sources.snippet: The installer adds the zils-miner and btcli commands. zils-miner setup asks for your wallet and Hugging Face repo, then zils-miner doctor checks each step and prints the next command: register, train a body, then commit it with zils-miner commit-body. Training needs Linux x86_64 with an NVIDIA GPU. Rerun the installer to update.

sources.title: GitHub - ooo-hq/zils-web: Zils decision-model website, research ...
sources.snippet: The Next.js website for Zils decision models, public research, the inference playground, and the experimental customer training dashboard. The intended production domain is https://zils.ai. The model and subnet implementation lives in ooo-hq/zils. The Fez chat application remains a separate project at fez.chat.
